display.purpose: Page H1s and the final call to action. Big Shoulders Display 900, uppercase. The door title runs two lines with the second in cobalt.

headline.purpose: Section H2s, held to about 12 to 16ch.

title.purpose: Tile, card, tool, lens and trace-state titles; road plates; gauges and phone numerals use the same face at 800 to 900.

title-text.purpose: Sentence-case Barlow 700 H4s and step titles.

body.purpose: Running text in Barlow (1.0625rem under 760px), 66 to 70ch in prose.

label.purpose: Uppercase Barlow 700 that names a panel, table column, fact or speaker. Never a lead-in above a headline.

button.purpose: Uppercase Barlow 700 on buttons and the mobile action bar.

shadows.name: button-contact
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow under yellow and cobalt buttons on light grounds; removed on line buttons and dark bands.

shadows.name: console-lift
shadows.purpose: The SAMPLE dashboard only, so it reads as a lifted device.

shadows.name: live-dot-halo
shadows.purpose: Status lamp halo on the live dot beside the header phone.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Double focus ring on inputs, selects and textareas.

shadows.name: input-invalid
shadows.purpose: Halo on invalid fields, paired with a red border.

shadows.name: cab-gasket
shadows.purpose: Cab-window rubber gasket drawn as one inset stroke on the window polygon.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for presses (160ms), arrow nudges (200ms), underline wipes (220ms), reveals (700 to 800ms), stripe draw (900ms) and image zooms (900ms).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active state on buttons and action-bar cells (0.95 to 0.99 on smaller controls).

motion.name: fleet-stripe-draw
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0) over 900ms ease-out; tape delayed 120ms
motion.purpose: Lays the livery on like vinyl when the page loads.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.08, rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0): opacity 0 and translateY(24px) to rest over 700/800ms ease-out
motion.purpose: One-shot entrance for elements with data-reveal.

motion.name: trace-scrub
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger: strokeDashoffset to 0, start top 60%, end bottom 65%, scrub 0.6; missed branch opacity scrub top 75% to top 50%
motion.purpose: The signature call trace draws as the reader scrolls.

motion.name: manifesto-words
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger: each word opacity 0.14 to 1, stagger 0.08, start top 78%, end bottom 42%, scrub 0.4
motion.purpose: Manifesto lines come up from faint to full.

motion.name: console-tilt
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger: scale 0.88, rotateX 8deg, opacity 0.55 to flat, top 92% to top 38%, scrub 0.5; fades to 0.35 on exit
motion.purpose: The SAMPLE console tilts upright into view.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: translateX(-50%) over 40s linear infinite; paused on hover

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animations collapse to 0.001ms, the marquee stops and wraps, reveals render in place, the stripe is not drawn, GSAP is skipped and every trace node is lit, and the hero video does not autoplay.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Nav tightens, logo 184px, road plates 5 to 3 columns.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Header 68px with menu button; two-column layouts stack; bento and console to 2 columns; trace pin unsticks.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Sticky mobile action bar; single-column grids; accordion becomes a vertical stack; door seam and photo pills removed.

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 26px; background: var(--yellow, #ffc915); color: var(--ink, #111216); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111216); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -12px rgba(17, 18, 22, 0.45); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--yellow-deep, #f0b400); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #1f3fd1); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); }

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; height: 76px; padding: 0 24px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground, #fbfbf9) 94%, transparent); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #111216); font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111216); } .ds-brand { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 10px 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 4px; height: 2px; background: var(--cobalt, #1f3fd1); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #1f3fd1); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-phone { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.45rem; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cobalt, #1f3fd1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--cobalt-tint, #e7ebfb); }

components.css: .ds-stripe { position: relative; height: 34px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-stripe::before, .ds-stripe::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -4%; transform: skewX(-32deg); transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-stripe-draw 900ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) both; } .ds-stripe::before { top: 0; height: 20px; right: 9%; background: var(--cobalt, #1f3fd1); } .ds-stripe::after { top: 25px; height: 9px; right: 4%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-58deg, var(--yellow, #ffc915) 0 16px, var(--ink, #111216) 16px 22px); animation-delay: 120ms; } @keyframes ds-stripe-draw { from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stripe::before, .ds-stripe::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is the side of a good work truck. The ground is fleet-white enamel; type is cut vinyl in sign black and reflex cobalt, set big enough to read from the road. The business name, the trade and the phone number are the hero, and the phone number is set at road scale, not tucked into a nav corner. Every surface is a flat panel joined by one 2px ink rule, with corners squared like plate edges. A cobalt-and-yellow fleet stripe on reflective-tape diagonals is the livery that closes the door panel and recurs as the brand's single decorative device.

Density is confident and blunt: tall condensed display lines at a 0.92 line height, short Barlow paragraphs held to 44 to 46 characters, grids of panels butted together with a 2px seam rather than floating cards with gaps. Colour carries meaning. Cobalt is the working voice (live line, the trace, booked, the AI speaking), yellow is the thing you press, and red is what a missed call costs. The world rejects the category's dark navy, purple-gradient AI glow and icon-tile cards.

Motion is mechanical and scroll-driven. The call trace draws as you read, manifesto words come up from faint, the SAMPLE console tilts upright into place, and the fleet stripe is laid on like vinyl from a roll. Everything has a static, fully legible state under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Fleet-white ground, sign-black ink, reflex-cobalt voice, safety-yellow actions, signal-red loss.
One 2px ink stroke for every rule, border, seam and icon; squared corners everywhere a panel or control exists.
Big Shoulders Display 900 in uppercase for anything lettered; Barlow for anything read.
Panels share seams: grids use a 2px ink gap on an ink ground instead of gutters between floating cards.
The phone number is display type, set at road scale on the door and in the final call to action.
Scroll-scrubbed signature motion with a custom ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) for everything else.

rules.name: The Yellow Means Go Rule
rules.body: Safety Yellow belongs to the action layer: buttons, the mobile Book bar, the Scorecard lead block, the fleet-stripe tape and the [ ... ] placeholder token. Use it to mark what to press or what is still missing, never as decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Red Means Loss Rule
rules.body: Signal Red marks what is lost: the missed call, its cost and the weakest lens. Form validation is the one functional exception. Red never decorates and never marks success.

rules.name: The Cobalt Speaks Rule
rules.body: When the business or its AI is doing the work (answering, booking, the live line), the type is cobalt. Ink is for the owner's own words.

rules.name: The Lettered or Read Rule
rules.body: If it should be read from across the road (names, numbers, states, titles), it is Big Shoulders Display 900 in uppercase. If it should be read up close, it is Barlow in sentence case. There is no third face and no mid-weight display.

rules.name: The Phone at Road Scale Rule
rules.body: The phone number is display type, never body-sized link text, wherever it is the primary content of a block.

rules.name: The Shared Seam Rule
rules.body: Adjacent panels share one 2px ink seam. Don't float cards on a gap of ground colour.

rules.name: The Painted Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels are paint on a door, not cards on a table. A new surface gets a 2px ink border or a seam, not a shadow.

rules.name: The One Stroke Rule
rules.body: One weight (2px, ink) for every rule and icon. A heavier line has to be a named device (trace, gasket, plate, focus), never a casual emphasis.

rules.name: The Plate Edge Rule
rules.body: Corners are square. Round only signal lamps.

dos: Do draw every border, seam, divider and icon with the single 2px ink stroke, and keep every corner square.
Do set names, numbers, states and titles in Big Shoulders Display 900 uppercase, and everything read up close in Barlow.
Do set the phone number in display type at road scale wherever it is the primary content.
Do reserve Safety Yellow for actions, the Scorecard lead block, the fleet-stripe tape and the [ ... ] placeholder token.
Do reserve Signal Red for missed-call loss and its cost, the weakest lens and form errors.
Do join grouped panels with a shared 2px ink seam (2px gap over an ink ground).
Do use the custom ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) for state transitions, a 0.97 press scale, and hover effects gated to pointer-fine devices.
Do label any illustrative dashboard or transcript with a visible SAMPLE tag, and mark every owner-supplied number with the placeholder token until it is real.
Do give every scroll-scrubbed and revealed element a complete static state under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use the category's dark navy, purple-gradient AI glow or icon-tile cards.
Don't round panel, button, input or image corners. Circles are for signal lamps only.
Don't use yellow as decoration, a highlight or a section background outside the Scorecard lead block.
Don't use red for emphasis, warnings unrelated to loss, or anything positive.
Don't float cards on ground-coloured gaps or give new surfaces drop shadows; borders and seams do the separating.
Don't introduce a third typeface or set display type below weight 800.
Don't put small uppercase lead-in lines above headlines; uppercase labels only name the contents of a panel, table or field.
Don't present invented results as real; use the placeholder token or the SAMPLE tag.
